request: Preserve the visible connection banner, make GitLab as usable as GitVerse, verify the connection after save and provide next actions; deliver to the hosted site rather than only a preview.
retainedDecisions: Banner remains visible on reload and revisit.
Save redirects to a separate result page with project and MR/PR navigation.
Green requires platform API read-back; errors and unconfirmed states never become green.
Connection state is not code-review, entitlement or CI success.
Retain selected projects, CSRF, protected cookies and GitVerse promo/hard-gate controls.
Keep GitHub/App review paths and the current OAuth callback configuration protections unchanged.
GitLab catalog Components UI is not owned by this application; direct installer entry remains available.
Describe what Peerivo Reviewer does on every installer page; show P brand monogram until the user supplies the exact logo file, without claiming that placeholder is the final logo.
scenarios: GitLab and GitVerse save -> 303 -> read-back -> result
Plain management reload keeps banner and selected inputs
Missing or disabled webhook; lost permission; expired session; denied CSRF; provider error
OAuth cancel; protected callback cookie; reauthorization
Deployment of merged SHA and anonymous public HTTP smoke
RU/EN product description and P monogram are visible on every installer page.
limitations: Automated provider fixtures are not live account authorization.
Authenticated user-session screen must not be claimed verified from anonymous smoke.
